newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait share index drops, trading value shrinks.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait share index drops, trading value shrinks.

text.p: Kuwait Stock Exchange's (KSE) index fell 5.6 points to 2,441.9 in the week to Wednesday which saw a sharp drop in trading value.
Daily average for value of traded shares fell almost 42 percent during the week to 31.58 million dinars ($104 million).
Pearl of Kuwait Real Estate Co shares were the most traded by volume and value during the week, closing at 178 fils compared with 180 on Tuesday and 176 last Wednesday.
Pearl shares set a new year high of 188 fils during Tuesday's session. There are 1,000 fils to the dinar.
International Financial Advisors shares, also among the most actively traded, closed at 385 fils -- unchanged from the previous day but five fils up from last week.
Financial shares set a new year high of 400 fils during Sunday's trading session.
Investment sector shares were the most traded followed by real estate concerns.
Only nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman and Kuwait -- can trade on the exchange. Foreign residents can invest in mutual funds.
The market was closed on Thursday, and will also be shut on Friday, for the weekend.
